'''''Cobalt Core''''' is a roguelike deckbuilder developed by [[Rocket Rat Games]] and published by [[Brace Yourself Games]].

==Gameplay==
Players play a variety of [[:Category:Cards|cards]] in order to carry out different actions over the course of the game - ranging from attacking to summoning drones.
